notice: ※ This is design guidance, not a cloud fact — confirm values, limits, and verdicts with the knowledge-base tools (kb_*/cap_*/cost_*).

items.question: Do the requirements say whether the application may keep state in the process itself (in-memory session, local files) or whether all state must live in a backing service?
items.citation: The Twelve-Factor App VI. Processes

items.question: Do the requirements say what may be lost when an instance is stopped or moved — in-flight work, uploads, background jobs?
items.citation: The Twelve-Factor App IX. Disposability
items.out_of_scope: 이미 있는 칸과 겹친다 — `RESOURCE_SPEC.stateless`가 같은 결정을 받는다. 새로 이으면 같은 답을 두 곳에서 받게 되고, 어긋날 때 어느 쪽이 진실인지 말할 수 없다

items.question: Do the requirements name the backing services the application consumes over the network (database, queue, cache, mail, object store)?
items.citation: The Twelve-Factor App IV. Backing services

items.question: Do the requirements say which values differ between environments (endpoints, credentials, feature switches) and who supplies them?
items.citation: The Twelve-Factor App III. Config
items.out_of_scope: 이미 있는 칸과 겹친다 — 환경별 값의 분리는 시크릿·설정 저장소 노드로 이미 표현된다(OpenAPI의 securitySchemes 신호). 별도 칸을 두면 같은 노드를 두 근거가 낳는다

items.question: Do the requirements say whether load is met by adding instances, and do they demand anything that pins a client to one instance (session affinity)?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Design to scale out

items.question: Do the requirements describe the shape of the load over time — steady, bursty, or scheduled peaks — and not only its size?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Autoscaling guidance

items.question: Do the requirements say what the application must do when a dependency fails briefly — retry, queue, degrade, or surface the error?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Transient fault handling
items.out_of_scope: 설계·구현 — 재시도·큐잉·성능저하 대응은 코드가 하는 일이라 배포 계획의 노드·값·판정 중 무엇도 이 답으로 달라지지 않는다

items.question: Do the requirements say which events must be recorded as a durable trail, and for how long they must be kept?
items.citation: The Twelve-Factor App XI. Logs
items.out_of_scope: 운영·감사 — 감사 추적은 로깅 아키타입이 받아야 하는데 `app::`에 로깅·모니터링 개념이 없다. `app::eventStream`은 이벤트 전달이지 감사 기록이 아니라 섞으면 안 된다

items.question: Do the requirements say what operations must be able to observe while the system runs — which measures are reported and which conditions raise alarm?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Design for operations

items.question: Do the requirements state an availability target, or which parts must survive the loss of a single instance, zone, or region?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Make all things redundant

items.question: Do the requirements state a volume that could meet a platform limit — stored data size, request rate, connection count, object count?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Partition around limits

items.question: Do the requirements constrain whether managed platform services may be used, or whether the team must run the component itself?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Use PaaS options

items.question: Do the requirements say where data must physically reside, or which jurisdiction's rules apply to it?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Availability zones and regions

items.question: Do the requirements state the expected load in numbers — concurrent users, requests per second, or data volume per period?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Capacity planning

items.question: Do the requirements state a target for response time or throughput, with the load at which it must hold?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Performance targets

items.question: Do the requirements say which flows must keep working, or keep their performance, when resources are scarce?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Prioritize critical flows
items.out_of_scope: 운영 — 어느 흐름이 살아 있어야 하는가는 SLO이고, 계획은 그 목표를 받아 무엇을 다르게 놓을지 아직 모른다. `cn.recovery-objective`(A갈래)가 다중화라는 형태로 그 일부를 받는다

items.question: Do the requirements state a spending ceiling, and what must happen when usage approaches it?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Set spending guardrails

items.question: Do the requirements state how much data may be lost and how quickly service must be restored after a disaster (RPO/RTO)?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Disaster recovery

items.question: Do the requirements say what the system may shed or degrade when it is overloaded or a dependency is unavailable?
items.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Framework — Design for graceful degradation
items.out_of_scope: 운영 — 과부하 때 무엇을 버릴지는 실행 중 정책이다. 계획은 무엇을 놓을지를 정할 뿐 부하 상황의 행동을 담지 않는다

items.question: Do the requirements say whether service may be interrupted during a release, and whether a release must be reversible?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Safe deployment practices
items.out_of_scope: 운영 — 무중단 배포는 릴리스 절차이지 배포 **구성**이 아니다. 블루/그린을 그리려면 계획이 아니라 파이프라인을 그려야 한다

items.question: Do the requirements say who may access what, and where identities come from (own accounts, corporate directory, external provider)?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Identity and access management

items.question: Do the requirements say which data is sensitive, and what class it belongs to (personal, financial, health, public)?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Data classification

items.question: Do the requirements state an encryption obligation for data at rest or in transit, and who must hold the keys?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Encryption

items.question: Do the requirements say what must be reachable from the public internet and what must not?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Networking and connectivity

items.question: Do the requirements say whether multiple customers or organisations share one deployment, and where the isolation boundary must fall?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Compute for SaaS workloads

items.question: Do the requirements set a limit on how much a single user or tenant may consume?
items.citation: Azure Well-Architected Framework — Throttling

items.question: Do the requirements place any constraint on energy use or carbon emissions?
items.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Framework — Use regions that consume low-carbon energy

items.question: Do the requirements name a regulation or certification regime the system must satisfy?
items.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Framework — Meet regulatory, compliance, and privacy needs

items.question: Do the requirements say what must hold when a multi-step operation fails half-way — must it be undone, retried, or left visible?
items.citation: Azure Architecture Center — Saga pattern
items.out_of_scope: 설계·구현 — 보상 트랜잭션·사가는 코드 구조의 문제다. 배포 계획은 어느 서비스를 놓을지만 정하고 그 안의 일관성 전략을 모른다
